follow100Note: The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
oneTimers: Office-space exit charges of $1.2B (plus $62M of accelerated rent and depreciation) sit inside the quarter's costs, mostly in unallocated corporate costs, as Alphabet shrinks its real-estate footprint; employee severance added just $7M this quarter, after $2.1B for the full year.
A January 2023 change that stretched the assumed life of Alphabet's servers from four to six years cut depreciation expense by $983M in this quarter alone, which flatters the profit comparison.
otherDetail: A $471M net gain on debt and equity securities plus interest income, partly offset by interest expense and other items, net.

segments.name: Google Services
segments.note: Search, YouTube, subscriptions and devices — Search & other revenue rose 13% to $48.0B and subscriptions, platforms and devices 23% to $10.8B.

segments.name: Google Cloud
segments.note: Cloud computing rented to companies — up 26%, and it swung to an $864M operating profit from a $186M loss a year ago.

segments.name: Other Bets
segments.note: Moonshot projects such as Waymo — small revenue and an $863M operating loss this quarter.

segments.name: Hedging gains
segments.note: Gains from currency hedging that sit outside the three businesses.

takeaways.text: Google Cloud revenue jumped 26% to $9.2B, and its operating result swung to an $864M profit from a $186M loss a year ago — the cloud is becoming a real second engine next to ads.
takeaways.title: Cloud swung to a profit

takeaways.text: Search & other revenue rose 13% to $48.0B, YouTube ads reached $9.2B, and subscriptions, platforms and devices grew 23% to $10.8B — Google Services earned $26.7B of operating profit in total.
takeaways.title: Search and subscriptions carried Services

takeaways.text: Operating margin reached 27%, up from 24% a year ago, even with $1.2B of office-space exit charges inside the quarter's costs — net income rose 52% to $20.7B.
takeaways.title: Margins widened despite the charges

verdict: Alphabet grew revenue 13% to $86.3B as Search rose 13% and Google Cloud jumped 26% and swung to a profit — and it kept $20.7B as profit, even after $1.2B of office-space exit charges.
